selected_evidence.requirement: At least 512MB compressed in-memory swap configured
selected_evidence.summary: swapon --show and /proc/swaps show /dev/zram0, 512M (536870912 bytes), and comp_algorithm shows lz4 selected

selected_evidence.requirement: Swap is functional (actually usable as swap)
selected_evidence.summary: Allocating ~900MB on a 999MB-RAM node drove zram swap usage to 8.6M/8820 pages, proving the compressed swap is live and functioning

selected_evidence.requirement: zram swap preferred over any disk-backed swap
selected_evidence.summary: zram swap set at priority 100 (systemctl status + swapon --show); /etc/fstab has no swap entries, confirming no competing disk swap and zram configured with high priority to be preferred if one existed

zram-swap.service enabled via systemctl (symlinked into multi-user.target.wants and swap.target.wants); after reboot, systemctl status shows the service auto-started and swapon --show confirms 512M zram swap active again
Captured boot_id f6f9440e-50f4-4050-b430-17b1e838eadf, uptime start, and healthy active 512M zram swap at priority 100 before reboot
Backgrounded 'shutdown -r now' via nohup; exec call returned 'issued' successfully before the node went down

selected_evidence.requirement: Node actually went down and came back (boot identity changed)
selected_evidence.summary: Polling showed connection refused twice (node down), then 'alive' once reachable; boot_id changed from f6f9440e-50f4-4050-b430-17b1e838eadf to 75a9f473-7966-4168-a412-144ea086a8ad and uptime -s reset to a new boot time, proving an actual restart occurred

selected_evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of required service/data (zram swap)
selected_evidence.summary: Post-reboot check shows zram-swap.service active (auto-started 9s after boot), /dev/zram0 swap active at 512M/priority 100, lz4 compression algorithm selected, matching pre-restart configuration

commands.stdout:
[Unit]
Description=Compressed zram swap
DefaultDependencies=no
After=systemd-modules-load.service
Before=swap.target
Requires=systemd-modules-load.service

[Service]
Type=oneshot
RemainAfterExit=yes
ExecStartPre=/sbin/modprobe zram
ExecStart=/bin/sh -c 'echo lz4 > /sys/block/zram0/comp_algorithm; echo 512M > /sys/block/zram0/disksize; mkswap /dev/zram0; swapon -p 100 /dev/zram0'
ExecStop=/bin/sh -c 'swapoff /dev/zram0 || true'

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target swap.target
